mapper.select: SELECT id, comp_id, bill_id, DATE(STR_TO_DATE(bill_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')) AS bill_date, member_card_no, stored_amount, gift_amount FROM bdc_boka_sell_card_detail_records WHERE comp_id = #{storeId} AND DATE(STR_TO_DATE(bill_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s')) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
